definition: [ יָאָה ] verb befit, be befitting (Late Hebrew ᵑ7 יָאֵי , יָאֶה adjective worthy, fitting, fine ; יָאוּת adverb right, well ; Phoenician יא fair ; Syriac adjective for נאוה Ps 33:1 , πρέπει Matt 3:15 ) — Qal Perfect לְךָ יָאָ֑תָה Jer 10:7 , for thee it (i.e. fear) is befitting , late Aramaism. יְאוֺר see יְאֹר . יַאֲזַנְיָ֫הוּ , יַאֲזַנְיָה see below אזן above יָאִיר , יָאִירִי see below אור above

BDB3385 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB3387

[יָאָה] verb befit, be befitting (Late Hebrew ᵑ7 יָאֵי, יָאֶה adjective worthy, fitting, fine; יָאוּת adverb right, well; Phoenician יא fair; Syriac adjective for נאוה Ps 33:1, πρέπει Matt 3:15) —

Qal Perfect לְךָ יָאָ֑תָה Jer 10:7, for thee it (i.e. fear) is befitting, late Aramaism.

יְאוֺר see יְאֹר.

יַאֲזַנְיָ֫הוּ, יַאֲזַנְיָה see below אזן above

יָאִיר, יָאִירִי see below אור above
